# Pause Match Time

Source: [wiki article 4399](../archive/4399.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Pause Match Time](../../api/actions/pause-match-time.md).

<a id="wiki-4399-n1"></a>

- Pause Match Time pauses only the match timer: players, objectives and game-mode advancement remain active.

<a id="wiki-4399-n2"></a>

- The archive says game lifetime closure still occurs after 4h30, or 1h30 in Practice Range.
